Grant money can be used to support festivals, workshops, performances and other events that present aspects of Japan to the UK or the UK to Japan in cultural, scientific, social, sporting and other spheres.

Grant money can be used to support exchanges between the two countries that enable participation and interaction, for instance of schools and sporting groups, artists, artisans, performers, scientists and researchers.
Grant money can be used to support collaborative projects involving UK and Japanese participants that result in new and innovative outputs for public, academic or professional presentation.
Grant money can be used to support the teaching and development of Japanese language and cultural studies in schools, and higher education.
Grant money can be used to support academic research, visits and exchange, where these push forward the boundaries of knowledge and understanding or involve collaboration and co-production.
